reported_shape_discrepancy.note: The Anomaly Transformer era result tables list 475200 training rows for SWaT, while the Time-Series-Library SWATSegLoader loads swat_train2.csv unchanged at 495000 rows and does not subsample. The 19800-row gap (5.5 hours at one-second sampling) is unresolved from the published artefacts, so the payload is used as shipped and the difference is carried into the reproduction comparison instead of being silently trimmed.

label_policy: native point labels from the Normal/Attack column; the reported benchmark additionally applies point adjustment
provenance: iTrust/SUTD Secure Water Treatment testbed; benchmark split as loaded by SWATSegLoader from the Time-Series-Library mirror
reference_loader_note: SWATSegLoader drops the trailing label column of both files; the attack label column is the detection target
